LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_CountTip: How many of this plant you can see on the map.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_ReadyTip: How many can be harvested now.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_NextTip: How long until the next growing plant is ready, at its current growth rate. Plants rest at night, and that is counted in.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_NextRowTip: The next one is ready in about {0}.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_SoonRowTip: {0} of the {1} growing will be ready within about 10 days.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_StalledRowTip: {0} are not growing now: out of season, too cold or hot, too dark, or blighted.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_GrowthStopsRowTip: Growth stops in about {0}, when it gets colder than {1}.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_RiskTip: How many are dying now (old age, blight, poison, light or vacuum), will reach old age within 7 days, or will be killed by frost within 7 days. Frost only kills crops and plants that die when leafless; wild plants just stop growing in the cold. Harvest these first.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_OldAgeRowTip: {0} will start dying of old age, the first in about {1}.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_FrostRowTip: {0} will be killed by frost, the first in about {1}.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_RiskHighlightTip: Hover the row to see them outlined in red on the map.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_NearTip: Cells from your base to the nearest one, in a straight line. The base is the middle of the home area.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_NearRowTip: The nearest {1} is {0} cells from your base.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_YieldTip: About how much harvesting every ready plant would give, after growth, damage and difficulty.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_MarkedTip: How many are already designated for harvest.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_CancelTip: Remove the harvest designation from every {0}.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_JumpTip: Click to jump to the next {0} on the map, ready ones first.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_IncludeTreesTip: Also list trees harvested for wood.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_IncludeCultivatedTip: Also list plants in growing zones and hydroponics basins.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_OnlyReadyTip: Hide plants with nothing ready to harvest.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_AreaTip: Only list plants inside this area. Harvest then marks only those.
LanguageData.Ordo_FloraTab_WithinTip: Only list plants this close to your base, in a straight line. Harvest then marks only those.
